name: AdaBelief
description: AdaBelief adapts stepsizes using the belief in observed gradients. foreach, fused, and capturable are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

parameters.backend_options: forwarded to torch.optim.AdaBelief when available; otherwise accepted by the local implementation

papers.title: AdaBelief Optimizer: Adapting Stepsizes by the Belief in Observed Gradients

examples.title: Optimize a quadratic objective with AdaBelief
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.adabelief import adabelief

params = [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(2.0)), torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(-1.0))]
optimizer = adabelief(params, lr=0.05)
loss = sum((parameter - 1.0).square() for parameter in params)
